rules.why: Skills are written through brain-write-skill, so they land in the routing map and pass lint.
Shipped skills are written through brain-write-skill.
Agents are written through brain-write-skill: explicit tools, a model, and the skill that dispatches them.
The routing map changes when a skill is placed, through brain-write-skill.
Scripts follow brain-write-script: placement, read-only by default, tests.
Capabilities are recorded from a probe, through brain-write-script.
An MCP server is a system: probed, recorded in CAPABILITIES.md, its secrets through secret run, through brain-write-script.
Mods are written through brain-write-mod: started from the kit, read-only by default, tested and linked.
Practices need evidence, a duplicate check and the index, through brain-write-practice.
Retro rows come with a proposed fix, through brain-retro.
Unclassified rows say what a skill would need, through brain-retro.
Upstream suggestions are written without private details, through brain-upstream.
